- Around line 175-179: The fallback arrays for apiIPs and ingressIPs are using
literal placeholder strings ('api' / 'ingress') that will leak into the UI;
update the logic around agentClusterInstall.spec.apiVIPs / apiVIP and
agentClusterInstall.spec.ingressVIPs / ingressVIP to stop inserting those
placeholders: either read the array fields directly
(agentClusterInstall.spec.apiVIPs and agentClusterInstall.spec.ingressVIPs) or,
if you keep a safety fallback to the singular fields (apiVIP / ingressVIP),
construct the arrays from the singular values and filter out falsy entries
(e.g., use a fallback like (agentClusterInstall.spec?.apiVIPs ??
[agentClusterInstall.spec?.apiVIP]).filter(Boolean) and similarly for ingress)
so only real IP strings are used by apiIPs and ingressIPs and nothing like
'api'/'ingress' is shown.
